name: Sniper
notes: Proposal. Long range, low damage rate; picks off officers and drone crews.

name: Mortar crew
notes: Proposal. Fires at targets seen by any defender (shared vision). Sits behind rocks and wrecks.

name: FPV drone operator
notes: Proposal. Sends one single-use FPV at a time at what the side sees: waits launch_delay_s, then picks by target_order (aviation, fast, heavy, infantry), the one furthest along first. Drones in the air are lost when the operator dies.

name: Bomber drone operator (Mavic type)
notes: Proposal. One reusable drone with 6 grenades: hovers over the target and drops one every drop_interval_s. Goes for troops first.

name: Recon drone
notes: Proposal. A spotter: no weapon, sees 120 m for the whole side (shared vision). Nothing of theirs can shoot it yet. Placed like any defender; sight still blocked by obstacles (no view from above yet).
